_comment: Installed to /etc/standby-ctl/config.json on the 0infer hypervisor. Everything not listed falls back to the defaults in standby_ctl.py; listing it here keeps the deployed values reviewable. primary_probes are the 0docker host's public ssh and edge ports; control_probes must answer, or 'primary unreachable' is treated as unknown. prod_dbname / rehearsal_dbname are the two databases an activation / a rehearsal must end up connected to: the controller checks compose's rendered config and the running containers against them and refuses a bundle whose .env names another one. dsn_host_map rewrites the HOST of POSTGRES_DSN in the bundle's production and staging .env (since the 2026-10-18 cutover the DSNs name VM701 by its tailnet address, which the standby cannot route to; it answers on its vmbr70 address); credentials and options are kept byte for byte. pg_cert is the pinned public server certificate of VM701 (host/pg-tls/, installed to /etc/standby-ctl/pg-tls/) that is put into the guest's data volume before the database probe, because the DSN verifies the server against /data/pg-tls/infer-pg-primary.crt.
